snippet.title: Mortal Shell II - Official Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
BETA sign-ups https://www.mortalshell.com
Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584270/Mortal_Shell_II/
Wishlist on PS5 https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010058
Wishlist on XBOX https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mortal-shell-ii/9NS9TJV1JL86
------------------------

Arise, Harbinger.

Watch the Mortal Shell II Official Gameplay Reveal.

Follow three warrior Shells as they carve separate paths through a hostile, interconnected open world.

------------------------
Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.
